final: WITH color_counts AS (SELECT p.product_color, COUNT(*) AS color_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), total AS (SELECT SUM(color_count) AS total_count FROM color_counts), ratios AS (SELECT cc.color_count, CAST(cc.color_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS ratio FROM color_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(color_count) AS average_count FROM ratios), kept AS (SELECT r.color_count, r.ratio, a.average_count FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN avg_count AS a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL AND r.color_count > a.average_count) SELECT (SELECT average_count FROM avg_count) AS average_count, AVG(ratio) AS average_count_divided_by_sum, AVG(color_count - average_count) AS average_excess_count FROM kept
